fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI répond à Lord Phillimore: Il se rallierait à son avis que „le mieux est parfois l'ennemi du bien", si le Pacte était „le bien", mais selon lui, le Pacte, sur ce point, est fort mal rédigé.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI answered Lord Phillimore. He would agree with his belief about "better opposed to good" if the Covenant were the "good", but in his opinion the Covenant on this point is very badly drafted.
